name: Maryland
gaps: The electric and plug-in hybrid surcharge was set at $125 and $100 a year by the Budget Reconciliation and Financing Act of 2024 and has been adjusted for inflation by the MVA since July 1, 2025; the current adjusted amount was not readable on an official page for this release (the MVA site refused access), so the line has no amount.

The VEIP emissions test fee was capped at $30 through June 30, 2026 and is then adjusted for inflation; the adjusted amount was not read on an official page, so the emissions test is shown without an amount.
The safety inspection required before titling a used car is priced by each licensed station; it is shown without an amount.

On a private sale of a car less than 7 years old, the excise is due on the book value when the price is $500 or more below it (unless a notarized bill of sale is accepted); a car 7 years or older is taxed on at least $640. The form does not ask the book value, so the engine taxes the price.

Registration fees are for a passenger car (Class A) by manufacturer's shipping weight; a pickup registered as a Class E truck pays a different schedule based on its maximum gross weight, which the form does not ask.
The engine uses a two-year registration; a one-year term is also offered (with a payment schedule), at half the amount.

summary.docFeeNote: Dealer processing charge capped at $800 since July 1, 2024, and included in the price subject to the 6.5% excise.
summary.inspectionWhere: Safety inspection at a licensed station before a used car is titled; VEIP emissions test every two years in Baltimore City and 13 counties (Anne Arundel, Baltimore, Calvert, Carroll, Cecil, Charles, Frederick, Harford, Howard, Montgomery, Prince George's, Queen Anne's, Washington).

tax.label: Motor vehicle excise tax (6.5%, minimum $100)
tax.note: 6.5% of the price including the dealer processing charge, minus the trade-in allowance.

reg.label: Class A passenger registration (2 years, by shipping weight)

cycle.label: Emergency medical system surcharge ($40 a year)

ranges.label: Zero-emission vehicle surcharge (two years, inflation-adjusted)
ranges.note: $125 a year in the 2024 law, adjusted for inflation by the MVA since July 1, 2025; both years are paid with a two-year registration.

ranges.label: Plug-in hybrid surcharge (two years, inflation-adjusted)
ranges.note: $100 a year in the 2024 law, adjusted for inflation by the MVA since July 1, 2025.

ranges.label: VEIP emissions test (every 2 years)
ranges.note: Required in Baltimore City and 13 counties; the fee was $30 through June 30, 2026 and is then adjusted for inflation.

ranges.label: Maryland safety inspection before titling a used car (station price)
ranges.note: A valid inspection certificate (90 days) is required before the MVA titles and registers a used vehicle.

singular: Maryland's purchase tax is an excise collected at titling: 6.5% of the vehicle's fair market value, with a $100 minimum [excise].
For a dealer sale, the taxed price includes the dealer processing charge and is reduced by the trade-in allowance [excise].

A private sale of a car 7 or more years old is taxed on at least $640; a younger car sold $500 or more below book value is taxed on the book value unless a notarized MVA bill of sale is accepted [excise].
Passenger car registration depends on shipping weight: $80.50 a year up to 3,500 lb, $85.50 up to 3,700 lb and $151.50 above, since July 1, 2025 [reg].
Every registration also carries a $40 yearly surcharge for the emergency medical system and Shock Trauma [ems].
Electric cars pay a yearly surcharge set at $125 and plug-in hybrids $100 by the 2024 budget law, adjusted for inflation every year since July 2025 [ev-law].
Dealer processing charges are capped at $800 for sales on or after July 1, 2024, and must be printed on the contract as not required by law [doc-fee].
A used car needs a Maryland safety inspection certificate, valid 90 days, before the MVA titles and registers it [safety].
Cars registered in Baltimore City and 13 counties take a VEIP emissions test every two years; the fee was $30 through June 30, 2026 [veip].

excise.name: Md. Code, Transportation §13-809, Excise tax on vehicle titling
excise.quote: “Total purchase price” means the price of a vehicle agreed on by the buyer and the seller, including any dealer processing charge, less an allowance for trade–in ... 6.5% of the fair market value of the vehicle ... the minimum tax imposed under this section shall be $100.

title.name: Md. Code, Transportation §13-802, Certificate of title fee
title.quote: the fee for each certificate of title issued under this title is $200.

reg.name: Md. Code, Transportation §13-912, Class A (passenger) vehicle registration fee
reg.quote: 3,500 pounds or less: ... On or after July 1, 2025, $80.50 ... more than 3,500 pounds but not more than 3,700 pounds: ... On or after July 1, 2025, $85.50 ... more than 3,700 pounds: ... On or after July 1, 2025, $151.50.

ems.name: Md. Code, Transportation §13-954, Registration surcharge
ems.quote: In addition to the registration fee otherwise required by this title, the owner of any motor vehicle registered under this title shall pay a surcharge of $40.00 per year for each motor vehicle registered.

ev-law.name: Md. Code, Transportation §13-956, Annual surcharge on zero-emission and plug-in vehicles
ev-law.quote: On or before July 1, 2025, of: (i) $125.00 for each zero–emission vehicle ... (ii) $100.00 for each plug–in electric drive vehicle ... After June 30, 2025, at a rate based on the amounts established under item (1) of this subsection adjusted for inflation as determined annually by the Administration.

ev-bulletin.name: Maryland MVA, Dealer Bulletin D-11-24-02 (Nov. 19, 2024), Annual surcharge for certain electric vehicles
ev-bulletin.quote: $125.00 each year for each ZEV • $100.00 each year for each PHEV ... If a customer wants a 2-year registration, the customer must pay the annual surcharge for both years at the time of registration.

doc-fee.name: Md. Code, Transportation §15-311.1, Dealer processing charge
doc-fee.quote: May not exceed: ... $800 on and after July 1, 2024 ... “Dealer processing charge (not required by law): $....”.

safety.name: Md. Code, Transportation §23-107, Inspection of used vehicles
safety.quote: Before the Administration titles and registers any used vehicle, except a Class L (historic) vehicle, it shall require a valid inspection certificate for the vehicle ... 90 days

veip.name: Maryland Department of Legislative Services, Fiscal and Policy Note, HB 806 (2026 session)
veip.quote: inspected and tested every two years ... may not exceed $30 through June 30, 2026. The current fee is $30 but must be adjusted in future fiscal years ... (Baltimore City and Anne Arundel, Baltimore, Calvert, Carroll, Cecil, Charles, Frederick, Harford, Howard, Montgomery, Prince George’s, Queen Anne’s, and Washington counties)
